informational_findings.finding: Dev added 'yarn install --frozen-lockfile && yarn workspace happy-cli build' BEFORE 'npm install -g .' (M11). The BA spec's M11 was just 'npm install -g .'.
informational_findings.analysis: This is LOAD-BEARING. Verified: packages/happy-cli/.gitignore contains '/dist'; packages/happy-cli/package.json files=['dist', 'bin', 'scripts', ...]. Without rebuild, 'npm install -g .' would pack the CURRENT (un-rolled-back) compiled output even though source files are at TARGET_TAG, defeating the rollback's purpose (daemon would run wrong code). deploy.sh implicitly rebuilds because its test step (deploy.sh:285) invokes 'yarn workspace happy-cli test' whose package.json script is '$npm_execpath run build && vitest run' — so deploy.sh's dist/ is always fresh. rollback.sh has no test step (intentional: 'rollback target should already be a known-good commit'), so dist/ would be stale without this explicit rebuild. The dev correctly identified this as carry-forward of deploy.sh:279-289.
informational_findings.verdict: BA-spec gap caught by dev; positive deviation. NOT a defect.
informational_findings.recommendation: Update BA spec in a future cycle to add this as M11b (post-reset rebuild) and AC18 to make it explicit. Until then, keep dev's implementation as-is.

informational_findings.finding: OTHER_UNTRACKED_COUNT counts ALL '^?? ' porcelain lines, but the message labels them '(outside sensitive paths)'.
informational_findings.analysis: If sensitive untracked existed, the script would have aborted unconditionally at line 275 BEFORE reaching line 279. So at line 279, by control flow, no sensitive untracked exists — only non-sensitive ones survive to be counted. The label is functionally correct because of the upstream abort. Dev self-review noted this and confirmed acceptable.
informational_findings.verdict: Acceptable; control flow ensures the count is effectively non-sensitive only.
informational_findings.recommendation: Optional future cleanup: filter the count to exclude sensitive paths explicitly to remove the cognitive load. Not required.
